'''Information about cot2v2:'''

The map cot2v2 is a revised version of the episode map E3M6, created specifically for the Blitzkrieg Cup 2on2 edition. Unimportant areas have been removed, and accessible routes via teleporters have been added. A central feature of the map is the quad room as well as the shaft area. To enhance teamplay, players can only reach the shaft if they work together, as access to the shaft can only be achieved with the help of a teammate.
